content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GTBH Consultants (Stenographers, Jr. Assistants, Sr. Assistants) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTBH). It is a government hospital located in Delhi, offering contract-based positions for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for GTBH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Consultants, which includes roles such as Stenographers, Jr. Assistants, and Sr. Assistants. These positions are available on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available for the Consultants (Stenographers, Jr. Assistants, Sr. Assistants) posts in this GTBH Recruitment 2026 drive. This offers a good opportunity for many applicants.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is "Walk-in". Candidates are required to attend an interview directly on the specified date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultants posts at GTBH is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should report to the venue well in advance of the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Consultants posts is 65 years. There are no specific minimum age criteria mentioned for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must be superannuated from the post of Sr. Assistant, Assistant Section Officer, or above to be eligible for these Consultant positions at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the GTBH Consultants Recruitment 2026. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview free of charge.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultants posts involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultants (Stenographers, Jr. Assistants, Sr. Assistants) positions at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital is "Contract". These are temporary engagements for a specified period.
